name: GuacaMol Molecule Generation Benchmark
description: A benchmark for de novo molecule generation that evaluates whether generated molecules satisfy property, novelty, diversity, and similarity constraints relevant to drug discovery.
evaluation_method: multi-objective scoring over validity, uniqueness, novelty, and property-optimization metrics; commonly includes aggregate benchmark scores and task-specific sub-scores
notes: GuacaMol is typically used to compare generative chemistry models on both distribution-learning and goal-directed tasks. There is no single question count because the benchmark is a suite of generation tasks.
